title: Guile - Autonomous pentesting for your entire stack
excerpt: Secure your code, APIs, web apps, infrastructure, and cloud with autonomous pentesting and proof-of-exploit findings.
content_html:
Autonomous red team · Always on

Find it. Prove it.
Before they do.

An always-on red team that tests your code, APIs, and infrastructure, then proves every finding before it becomes an incident.

24 / 7 attack coverageProof for every finding

GUILE AGENT / LIVE

AUTONOMOUS RED TEAM
ALWAYS WATCHING

TARGETS / 04STATUS / ACTIVE

Scroll to explore

About Guile

Offensive coverage, always on

Attack paths change.
Your coverage should too.

Modern stacks move too quickly for periodic testing to keep up. Guile continuously attacks the places your users, services, and identities meet, then turns validated vulnerabilities into a clear sequence of what to fix next.

GU / ABOUT

"Know the attack path before someone else discovers it."

Autonomous pentesting

Built for the pace of shipping

Find it.
Prove it. Fix it.

Attack

Guile continuously explores your stack like an attacker, testing real paths across code, APIs, apps, infrastructure, and cloud.

Prove

Every finding includes proof-of-exploit evidence so your team can see the path, impact, and affected asset.

Fix

Move from discovery to remediation with clear reproduction steps and focused work your engineering team can act on.

Full-stack coverage

One platform, every surface

Nothing
left untested.

Code

Find vulnerabilities before they become production paths attackers can use.

REST + GraphQL

Test authentication, authorization, business logic, and data exposure across every API.

Web apps

Trace real user flows, permissions, and application logic from the outside in.

Infrastructure + cloud

Keep hosts, services, identities, and cloud configurations in the same attack narrative.

"Pentesting for the way
software is actually made."

- The Guile thesis

Questions, answered

Before we begin

A few useful
coordinates.

What does Guile test?-

Guile provides full-coverage pentesting across code, REST and GraphQL APIs, web apps, infrastructure, and cloud environments.

What does proof-of-exploit mean?+

Every validated finding includes evidence of the attack path, what was reached, and why the issue matters so your team can reproduce and prioritize it.

How often does Guile run?+

Guile works continuously, helping you find and fix vulnerabilities 24/7 as your product, infrastructure, and cloud environment change.

Will Guile replace our security team?+

Guile gives security and engineering teams always-on offensive coverage while people stay in control of risk decisions and remediation.

Start securing
